The edit fixes the heart rate (75 is at the limit), removes any bleeding history, and moves the site to tier B. Tier B is not tier C, so the age rule R2 doesn't apply. The risk is R6: if the original case relied on the tier A exception for creatinine clearance, tier B would now fail it. Since the denial named only heart rate, that seems less likely, so I lean toward approve.
